verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing showing Honeycomb can be self-hosted. The material describes a hosted SaaS service: you send OTLP data to Honeycomb, pick an EU or North America account region, and choose among hosted pricing plans. With no evidence of a self-hosted or on-prem deployment option, the verdict is none.
